recipe.scope: Candidate development only, using existing prefix-v1 train/development/calibration surface forms. No old or new test is read. Correct and wrong-layout forms share contexts and a fixed physical-family budget. Existing typo forms are KEEP only. Prefix substring groups are not claimed globally unseen. Promotion requires a future frozen joint engine evaluation with actual default early behavior, context model, physical events and prospective document/physical-lemma holdout.
recipe.training_revision: experiment03: every available old TRAIN physical family (1352 of 1352) and 120 epochs; DEV frontier selection, thresholds, CAL gates, data revision and schema unchanged
